arm_descriptions.description: all three mechanisms on, exactly as the engine ships
only the target's most recent direct claim seeds the search; the places it was claimed to be earlier are not kept as live alternatives
a container that leaves a stop with plausible cargo no longer counts against the object still being where its carrier left it
repeating an action that already came up empty costs the robot nothing in the ordering of what to do next

grading: correct = the robot committed and the place it committed to is the hidden truth; wrong = it committed elsewhere; no_verdict = it never committed within the budget
